description: This file contains classes and functions for integrating with GitHub, including parsing Python files to identify FastAPI endpoints and classes, managing GitHub repositories, and creating pull requests for code updates and tests.

classes.name: DefinitionVisitor
classes.description: AST NodeVisitor that identifies class definitions, function definitions, FastAPI app instances, and endpoints within a Python source file.

classes.name: RepoHelper
classes.description: Helper class for interacting with GitHub repositories, parsing Python files to index functions and classes, and managing pull requests and code updates.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DefinitionVisitor, initializes filepath and lists for definitions and FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: visit_ClassDef
methods.description: Visits class definitions and records them.

methods.name: visit_FunctionDef
methods.description: Visits function definitions and processes them, checking for FastAPI endpoint decorators.

methods.name: visit_AsyncFunctionDef
methods.description: Visits asynchronous function definitions and processes them similarly to sync functions.

methods.name: process_function
methods.description: Processes a function node, recording it and checking for FastAPI route decorators.

methods.name: enrich_callgraph_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches nodes in a call graph with GitHub data such as file path and function content.

methods.name: _build_index
methods.description: Builds an index of classes, functions, FastAPI apps, and endpoints from the repository contents.

methods.name: _process_python_file
methods.description: Parses a Python file, visits its AST to identify definitions and FastAPI endpoints, and updates the index.

methods.name: lookup_index
methods.description: Retrieves indexed data for a given symbol name and type.

methods.name: get_fastapi_app
methods.description: Returns the FastAPI app definitions found in the repository.

methods.name: get_fastapi_endpoints
methods.description: Returns the list of FastAPI endpoint definitions.

methods.name: identify_app_for_endpoint
methods.description: Heuristically determines which FastAPI app a given endpoint belongs to based on directory structure.

methods.name: enrich_node_with_github_data
methods.description: Enriches a node with GitHub data such as file path, function implementation, and file content.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_new_function
methods.description: Creates a pull request to update a function implementation on GitHub, including context and reasoning.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_test
methods.description: Creates a pull request adding a new test file.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_multiple_tests
methods.description: Creates a pull request adding multiple test files and coverage summary.
